title: Toast
summary: Transient overlay feedback with semantic roles, optional action, pause-safe lifetime and dismiss behavior.

status.description: What the message reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The words this component used before — default and primary — are still accepted and mean neutral and info.

supporting-text.description: Concise supporting text at the normal body size.

action-text.description: Visible label of the one optional action.

action.description: Stable action value emitted in sf-toast-action.

closable.description: Render an explicitly named close action.

close-label.description: Localized accessible name of the close action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close message" in English).

duration.description: Explicit lifetime in milliseconds. Zero keeps the message until dismissed.

role.description: Live-region role for dynamically inserted feedback only.

type.description: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

lifetime.persistent: duration=0; required for messages whose action or content must not be missed
lifetime.timed: positive duration; pauses while pointer or keyboard focus is inside the toast
lifetime.dismiss: token motion completes before the visual owner is removed

live_region_guidance.assertive: role=alert only for a newly inserted urgent error
live_region_guidance.polite: role=status for a newly inserted non-urgent result
live_region_guidance.static: omit a live-region role when the toast is present on initial page load

close.summary: Same as dismiss: emits sf-toast-close and removes the toast.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute: false, null, undefined or empty removes it, true sets it empty, anything else is stringified.

onAction.summary: Adds a listener for sf-toast-action; the handler is called with (action, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onClose.summary: Adds a listener for sf-toast-close; the handler is called with (detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

sf-toast-action.summary: Emitted once when the optional enabled action is activated.

action.description: data-action or data-toast-action of the pressed control; empty when neither is set.

sf-toast-close.summary: Emitted once before token-based dismissal removes the toast owner.

trigger.description: The close control that was pressed; null when closed from code or by the timer.

accessibility.focus: Native actions use focus-visible; a timed toast pauses while focus is inside it.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-toast for concise transient overlay feedback that does not block the current task.
do_not: Do not use Toast for persistent inline guidance; use Alert
Do not auto-dismiss a message whose content or action must not be missed
Do not use role=alert for routine success feedback
Do not choose a semantic type only for its color
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-toast status="success" title="Saved" supporting-text="Your changes are available." role="status" close-label="Close message"></sf-toast>
